_about: Everything on the Studio page. Each product shows only if it has no gate. Claude fills a gate's blank when Josef answers, then clears the gate. Counts on join lists show only at 10 or more. The hero shows only intro. The meta description uses lede_album_gated while the album card is hidden, so it names the album only when the album shows. kind and kicker are kept but not printed (T-16); the page title is the kicker's first part. The gallery's words live in "gallery" too: its heading, each app's name, each group's label and caption, and each image's caption and alt text. Its images are in assets/gallery, and studio.py numbers the captions of a group marked numbered.

products.name: Bird League
products.what: Fantasy sports for birders. Draft real species, then score points against your league each week by finding them in the wild.
products.proof: Build 49 names birds from a photo or a song, and sends sightings to eBird in one tap.
products.image_alt: Then: an early Bird League screen that still says mock data. Now: build 49's life list wall.

products.what: Indie games matched by how they actually play, not by what's trending.

products.name: A kids' cooking app
products.what: The program's own recipes, in an app teachers cook from in class, with a grocery list that scales to the class and pages that print like their own cards. iPhone, iPad, Android and the web.
products.proof: 535 tests, and every change checked on a real phone before it ships.

products.name: COBOL, checked in public
products.what: Two different AIs translated the same COBOL interest program. The code, the prompts and every miss are published for anyone to rerun.

products.what: A reel shot list, a caption fitter, a busywork receipt, a recipe scaler and a COBOL field decoder. They run in your browser, and nothing you type leaves the page.

items.caption: A spreadsheet
items.alt: Deepcuts as a spreadsheet: indie games ranked by match score, each with its developer.
Today's Dig in the Deepcuts app: one game picked for you, with its fit score and why it was picked.
Your Keeps: the games you saved, each with Started, Finished and Bounced buttons.
The Rooms screen: rooms for games, gifts, records and books, each marked open.
A taste profile, The Grand Strategist, with sliders from Depth to Breadth and Solo to Social.

items.caption: The first build
items.alt: An early Bird League screen that names birds by sound and still says mock data.
Bird League's home screen: a countdown to the Winter Big Day, the trophy case and recent sightings.
The Log screen: type a bird's name or identify it by sound or photo, then log it to your leagues or your life list.
A league card: this week's matchup, your rank, your points and the days left in the season.
The life list wall: birds grouped by family, with the ones you've seen in color.
The life list: 141 species, and how many of the birds reported near home you've seen.
Life list records: the heaviest, lightest and widest-winged birds seen, and a size parade.
A player profile: lifetime points, species, sightings, leagues and the next goals.
The badge case: earned badges in color and locked ones in gray.
